bio.text: Martin McLaughlin has represented the 52nd District in the Illinois House of Representatives since January 2021.
The legislature biography describes him as Village President of Barrington Hills and a small businessman specializing in pension management.
He holds a bachelor's degree in business administration from Illinois Wesleyan University and previously chaired the Barrington Area Council of Governments.
